name: Engineering Summer Camps for Ages 14 to 17
org: University of Nevada, Reno College of Engineering
what_you_do: Pick one high school camp. The page lists the Aerospace Mini-Camp, the Engineering Adventures Camp and a Civil and Environmental Engineering Camp. Camp details are not posted yet.
pay_detail: Fee not listed on the page. A $50 non-refundable deposit can hold a spot; full payment is due within a month of registering. Scholarships available.
duration: Camp dates not listed on the page
deadline_text: Summer 2027 registration opens February 1 (2027 inferred from the Summer 2027 label on the page).
how_to_apply: Sign up online when it opens on February 1. For a scholarship, add an essay on your interests and a teacher recommendation letter to the form. Questions: paigefroese@unr.edu.
notes: Camp prices and dates were not posted when this was checked. Check back before February.
